input.summary: Remove the Customer-payable late-payment liquidated damages in § 7.7 and replace it with an express no-liquidated-damages provision.
input.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept liquidated damages payable by us, particularly 15% of annual Fees per week for a ten-day late invoice, so we have replaced § 7.7 with an express statement that we owe no liquidated damages or penalties. If some liquidated amount is unavoidable, our fallback is a sole early-termination fee capped at three months' fees.

ops.oldText: 7.7 If any invoice is not paid within ten days of its due date, Customer shall pay Vendor, as liquidated damages and not as a penalty, an amount equal to fifteen percent of the annual Fees for each week the invoice remains unpaid.
ops.newText: 7.7 Customer shall not be liable for any liquidated damages or penalties under this Agreement.
